description: Road design guide is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The purpose of this document is to provide guidelines to ensure that there is a consistent approach to road design by the Authority. It should not be recognised as a standard, rather its purpose is to define the usual limits of preferred practice. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
